caseName: Von Schoenbeck v. Koninklijke Luchtvaart Maatschappij N.V.
caseNameFull: Johanna VON SCHOENBECK, et vir v. KONINKLIJKE LUCHTVAART MAATSCHAPPIJ N.V., aka KLM Royal Dutch Airlines.

opinions.text: Motion of Flyers Rights Education Fund and Travelers United for leave to file brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied.
